content.text: {"screening_id":"SCR_000098","question_assessments":[{"domain_id":"D1","question_id":"1.1","agent_response":"NI","evidence_location":"Page 1, Methods—Participants and intervention; Figure 1B, study flowchart","evidence_summary":"The report states that 178 patients were randomized 1:1, but does not describe how the allocation sequence was generated.","rationale":"Labeling the study randomized does not establish that a genuinely random sequence-generation method was used.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D1","question_id":"1.2","agent_response":"NI","evidence_location":"Page 1, Methods—Participants and intervention","evidence_summary":"No central randomization, pharmacy-controlled allocation, sealed envelopes, or other allocation-concealment procedure is reported.","rationale":"There is insufficient information to determine whether assignments could have been foreseen before enrollment and allocation.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D1","question_id":"1.3","agent_response":"N","evidence_location":"Page 2, Figure 1C; page 3, Results","evidence_summary":"The authors report that baseline characteristics were well balanced. The displayed characteristics, including age, sex, BMI, insulin dependence, HbA1c, surgery type, and bypass time, show no clearly important imbalance.","rationale":"The observed baseline data do not suggest failure of randomization, although reporting of baseline variables is limited.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D2","question_id":"2.1","agent_response":"Y","evidence_location":"Page 1, Introduction and Methods—Participants and intervention; page 3, Discussion—Limitations","evidence_summary":"The trial is explicitly described as open-label, with dapagliflozin added to standard care and no placebo used in the control group.","rationale":"Participants would ordinarily know whether they received dapagliflozin.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D2","question_id":"2.2","agent_response":"Y","evidence_location":"Page 1, Methods—Participants and intervention; page 3, Discussion—Limitations","evidence_summary":"The open-label intervention required clinicians to administer, withhold, and restart dapagliflozin, while controls received standard care without an SGLT2 inhibitor.","rationale":"Intervention providers necessarily knew treatment assignment.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D2","question_id":"2.3","agent_response":"NI","evidence_location":"Pages 1–3, Methods and Results","evidence_summary":"The report describes the intended dosing schedule but does not provide adherence data, protocol-deviation counts, or information about differential co-interventions relevant to acute kidney injury.","rationale":"It cannot be determined whether awareness of assignment or other trial-context factors caused deviations from intended care.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D2","question_id":"2.4","agent_response":"NI","evidence_location":"Pages 1–3, Methods and Results","evidence_summary":"No relevant deviations or differential co-interventions are described.","rationale":"Because the occurrence and nature of deviations are unknown, their potential effect on postoperative acute kidney injury cannot be assessed.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D2","question_id":"2.5","agent_response":"NI","evidence_location":"Pages 1–3, Methods and Results","evidence_summary":"The publication does not compare protocol deviations, adherence, or relevant co-interventions between groups.","rationale":"There is insufficient evidence to determine whether any deviations were balanced.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D2","question_id":"2.6","agent_response":"N","evidence_location":"Page 3, Statistical analysis and Results; Figure 1B","evidence_summary":"The analysis used a modified intention-to-treat population, excluding 14 randomized patients who did not undergo surgery: 8 of 89 assigned dapagliflozin and 6 of 89 assigned control.","rationale":"For an effect-of-assignment estimand, excluding randomized participants after allocation is not a full intention-to-treat analysis. Although postoperative AKI cannot be observed without surgery, the analysis is conditional on a post-randomization event.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D2","question_id":"2.7","agent_response":"PY","evidence_location":"Page 3, Statistical analysis and Results; Figure 1B","evidence_summary":"Approximately 7.9% of randomized participants were excluded, and the reported AKI result was essentially null: 40.7% versus 41.0%, RR 0.99.","rationale":"With a null result and 14 post-randomization exclusions, differential outcomes under surgery could alter the estimate. The similar exclusion counts and stated reason reduce, but do not remove, this concern.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D3","question_id":"3.1","agent_response":"N","evidence_location":"Page 3, Results; Figure 1B","evidence_summary":"AKI was analyzed for 164 of 178 randomized patients. Eight dapagliflozin and six control participants were excluded because they did not undergo surgery.","rationale":"Outcome data were unavailable for about 7.9% of randomized participants, which is more than a negligible proportion.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D3","question_id":"3.2","agent_response":"PY","evidence_location":"Figure 1B; page 3, Results","evidence_summary":"The only stated reason for exclusion was failure to undergo surgery, occurring in similar numbers across groups. No sensitivity analysis including these participants is reported.","rationale":"The timing, stated reason, and group balance provide some evidence against outcome-dependent missingness, but do not conclusively demonstrate that the result was unbiased.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D3","question_id":"3.3","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Figure 1B","evidence_summary":"Missing postoperative AKI data arose because participants did not undergo surgery, rather than because AKI measurements were selectively unavailable after surgery.","rationale":"Missingness is unlikely to depend directly on an observed postoperative AKI value, although reasons for not proceeding to surgery could be associated with underlying renal risk.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D3","question_id":"3.4","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Figure 1B; page 3, Results","evidence_summary":"Exclusions were similar between groups and occurred before the postoperative outcome could arise; individual reasons for cancellation are not supplied.","rationale":"Dependence on the participant's potential AKI outcome appears unlikely, but cannot be excluded because detailed reasons and sensitivity analyses are absent.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D4","question_id":"4.1","agent_response":"N","evidence_location":"Page 1, Methods—Outcomes","evidence_summary":"Perioperative AKI was defined according to established KDIGO criteria, with postoperative serum creatinine trajectories also reported.","rationale":"KDIGO criteria are an appropriate and standard method for measuring postoperative acute kidney injury.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D4","question_id":"4.2","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Page 1, Methods—Outcomes; Figure 1E","evidence_summary":"The same KDIGO definition and postoperative observation window appear to have been applied to both randomized groups.","rationale":"There is no indication that AKI ascertainment or laboratory testing differed by treatment group, although detailed measurement schedules are not fully described.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D4","question_id":"4.3","agent_response":"N","evidence_location":"Page 1, final paragraph of Introduction","evidence_summary":"The study is described as a randomized, open-label, blinded-endpoint trial.","rationale":"The explicit blinded-endpoint design indicates that outcome assessors were not intended to know intervention assignment.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D4","question_id":"4.4","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Page 1, Methods—Outcomes","evidence_summary":"AKI was determined using KDIGO criteria based on objective renal measurements.","rationale":"Even if some personnel knew assignment, objective creatinine-based criteria leave limited scope for assessor judgment to influence classification.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D4","question_id":"4.5","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Page 1, Introduction and Methods—Outcomes","evidence_summary":"Endpoint assessment was described as blinded and the AKI definition was objective.","rationale":"It is unlikely that knowledge of treatment influenced the measured AKI incidence.","agent_confidence":"High"},{"domain_id":"D5","question_id":"5.1","agent_response":"PY","evidence_location":"Page 3, Statistical analysis; page 4, Pre-registered Clinical Trial Number","evidence_summary":"AKI is identified as the key secondary endpoint; the sample-size calculation included AKI incidence, and a prespecified hierarchical testing strategy is reported. The trial is described as preregistered under NCT05621551.","rationale":"These features support prospective specification of the AKI analysis, although the full protocol or statistical analysis plan and its date are not provided in the article.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D5","question_id":"5.2","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Page 1, Methods—Outcomes; page 3, Results; Figure 1E","evidence_summary":"The defined key secondary endpoint was perioperative AKI incidence according to KDIGO criteria, and this incidence is reported directly. Serum creatinine AUC is presented as a separate renal-injury measure.","rationale":"There is no clear evidence that the AKI incidence result was selected from multiple eligible definitions, measurement methods, or time points.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"},{"domain_id":"D5","question_id":"5.3","agent_response":"PN","evidence_location":"Page 3, Statistical analysis and Results; Figure 1E","evidence_summary":"The report presents group incidences, a relative risk, confidence interval, and P value for AKI in the stated modified intention-to-treat population.","rationale":"Although the statistical methods are only briefly described and the full analysis plan is unavailable, there is no indication that this null estimate was selected from multiple competing analyses.","agent_confidence":"Moderate"}],"domain_assessments":[{"domain_id":"D1","provisional_domain_judgement":"Some concerns","domain_rationale":"The study is described as randomized and shows no concerning baseline imbalance, but neither sequence generation nor allocation concealment is reported."},{"domain_id":"D2","provisional_domain_judgement":"Some concerns","domain_rationale":"The open-label design creates potential for deviations, and adherence, protocol deviations, and relevant co-interventions are not reported. In addition, the modified intention-to-treat analysis excluded 14 randomized participants based on the post-randomization occurrence of surgery."},{"domain_id":"D3","provisional_domain_judgement":"Some concerns","domain_rationale":"Outcome data were not available for 14 of 178 randomized participants. Exclusion because surgery did not occur, with similar numbers between groups, makes outcome-dependent missingness unlikely, but detailed reasons and sensitivity analyses are unavailable."},{"domain_id":"D4","provisional_domain_judgement":"Low","domain_rationale":"AKI was measured using standard KDIGO criteria in a trial described as having blinded endpoint assessment. The objective outcome method was unlikely to be influenced by treatment awareness."},{"domain_id":"D5","provisional_domain_judgement":"Low","domain_rationale":"AKI was explicitly designated as a key secondary endpoint, contributed to the sample-size calculation, and was subject to a stated prespecified hierarchical strategy in a preregistered trial. There is no clear evidence of selective choice among measurements or analyses, though the complete protocol and analysis plan were not supplied."}],"agent_overall_provisional_judgement":"Some concerns","agent_overall_rationale":"The target AKI result has low risk from outcome measurement and no clear evidence of selective reporting. However, reporting is insufficient for sequence generation and allocation concealment, the open-label trial does not document deviations or adherence, and 14 randomized participants were excluded from the modified intention-to-treat analysis because they did not undergo surgery. These issues warrant some concerns but do not provide evidence of bias serious enough for a provisional high-risk judgement."}
